spec_match.rationale: Each row checks a contract from the spec (channel created in the BaseAudioContext constructor, port2 transferred to the scope, readonly) or from HTML MessagePort rules (start(), transfer, DataCloneError, close()); this mirrors the WPT audioworklet-messageport assertions.

interactive.rationale: One run button drives 11 real experiments across three contexts and fills a results table and verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page runs.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unsupported attribute through a labelled old-pattern fallback, addModule/context failures with verbatim error text, and re-run guards against double clicks.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5079784523694080, the spec anchors and related concepts.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite has 9 assertions: 1 passes on Chrome 153 (per-node port) and 8 fail because the attribute is absent. That matches the fallback seen here, but the success-path assertions have not been seen to pass in any browser in this environment.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Fallback run: 10 rows reported 'blocked' (none counted as passed); the migration row passed using a bootstrap AudioWorkletNode echo. Verified with headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification). Zero console errors; contexts closed after the run.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers both the shared branch and the fallback branch, plus error paths.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; any button override also sets color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose/amber on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, labelled selects, inputs and radios; visible focus outlines; polite live verdicts; focusable code and table regions. Accessibility tree not inspected with DevTools MCP.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch) and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow, 44px controls, screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify the shared-port success path in a Chrome build that implements AudioWorkletSharedPort
openQuestions.detail: Chrome for Testing 153 exposes no AudioWorklet.prototype.port even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features or --enable-blink-features=AudioWorkletSharedPort, so only the labelled fallback path ran. Re-run this concept in a current Canary with the flag (or Firefox 138+) and confirm the shared branch end to end.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the close() and start() rows in a supporting build
openQuestions.detail: The timing windows (500/600 ms) are assumptions until they are run against a real implementation.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for async status results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use one polite live region per status surface; do not make noisy logs live; announce errors.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each stage has a single aria-live=polite verdict; message logs are plain ordered lists (not live) to avoid announcement spam.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap control rows, size intrinsically, wrap long monospace strings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Flex-wrap control rows, auto-fit ledger grid, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/output; measured 0px overflow at 360px and 1280px.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid/flex with min-width:0 to stop children forcing overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Stage children get min-width:0; fieldset labels are block so inline code wraps with its text.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data table for measurement results on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap tables in a focusable role=region with an accessible name from the caption; use th scope.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Results table sits in tabindex=0 role=region aria-labelledby=caption wrapper with scope=col/row headers; result cells nowrap so verdicts stay legible.

summary: Interactive demo of the exact shared-port surface with an honest, labelled bootstrap-node fallback. Only the fallback could be verified, because this environment has only Chrome 153.
